name: 15-Second Creamy Scrambled Eggs
dish: One serving of very soft, custardy scrambled eggs, starch-thickened and cooked in about 15 seconds in lots of butter.

stages.do: heat dry pan first, then butter
stages.cue: butter melted and foaming, not yet browning

stages.do: pan off burner; stir in circles, one lap per second
stages.cue: butter all taken up, eggs still a bit wet/underdone

stages.do: plate right away; residual heat finishes them
stages.cue: do not hold until fully cooked-looking

notes: Timing is the whole method: 3 s still + 11–12 s stirring. Eggs leave pan slightly undercooked on purpose.
